request.prompt: Cozy whimsical fantasy inn game, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, readable chunky shapes, limited muted moss green and warm brown palette, restrained shading, no text, no interface, no blur. One wide low stone doorstep viewed straight down, a simple overhead 16-bit floor object for a forest inn entrance. Long horizontal rectangular shape, nearly four times wider than tall, two shallow parallel treads, weathered muted slate gray-green with lighter upper edge. A few chunky flat stone pixels. Whole object centered with transparent padding. No closed door, arch, wall, grass, road or room.
